variants.name: Flechette
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 flechettes, six small dart projectiles specially designed to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover.

variants.name: .410 Bore
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 buckshot, four average sized pellets that are great for putting down pesky human-sized vermin.
Functions almost identically to the Judge default ammo.

variants.name: Birdshot
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration. Wider pellet spread due to wider choke.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Exotic Slugs
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a .410 slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

variants.name: Rubber Pellets
variants.info:
Changes your load to .410 rubber pellets, three rubber balls projectiles specially designed to make a target feel stinging pain.
Great for close range encounters but hardly make a difference at long range.
